lines.zh: 我贴着地面移过去，很轻。
lines.en: I move along the ground, very light.
My body draws out long.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，没有声音。
lines.en: I close in step by step, silent.
I slide forward without a single twitch.
I angle slightly your way.

lines.zh: 我的边缘在空气里划过。
lines.en: My edge cuts through the air.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，雾被分开。
lines.en: The mist parts where I pass.
I leave a line on the ground.
I come around the corner.
I slide another stretch forward.
I hang, swaying slightly.
My edge has gone blunt.
I am trying to hold my shape.
The mist is thick here.
My point is as blunt as a broken needle.
I could not hold it this time.
Another seam opens.

lines.zh: 雾里有回声，我跟着偏了。
lines.en: An echo in the fog pulls me off course.
My voice is very thin.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能刺的目标。
lines.en: I am waiting for something worth piercing.
I turn my front toward you.
I tilt my body.
I try to line you up.
Another seam opens in me.
There is plenty of life in you.
I brought my front a little nearer.
I hung there and watched you for ages.

lines.zh: 我试着对准你，可形状不太稳。
lines.en: I try to aim at you, but my shape will not hold.
I scatter and gather again.
A piece of my shape is gone.
I slowly fix my shape.
Another corner is gone from me.
I drew back a long way.
I feel no pain, only instability.
My edge has thinned.
I am trying to aim again.
I am unsure how long I can hold.
That is not my target.
I do not live on such things.
I turn my front aside.
One glance and I looked away.
I am still trying to line you up.

lines.zh: 你的食物穿不过我这一层。
lines.en: Your food cannot pass through my layer.
You keep this.
My body does not take such things.
It would only throw me off.
You strike me and I skew aside.
I slowly realign.
There is little of me to hit.
That threw me off a long way.
My edge touched you.
I drew myself back in.
I steady myself against the wall.
Do not push me.
My shape has loosened.
I have not shifted from where I was.

lines.zh: 我被做坏的时候就少了一块。
lines.en: Something was missing when I was made.
I cannot do that.
I cannot even keep steady.
I scattered a little and gave no answer.
I am trying not to come apart.
I turned my front away.

lines.zh: 我连这个形状都不完整。
lines.en: I am not even a complete shape.
I drifted off elsewhere.
I try to draw it in.
It passed straight through me.
I cannot press anything down.

lines.zh: 我是做坏的那个，别学我。
lines.en: I'm the failed one; don't copy me.
It slides out of me.
This is too solid.
I pushed it to your hand.
This is no use to me.
I have nowhere to put it.
My front points at you.
I pause and narrow my shape.
I am ready to drive through.
My front has drawn tight.
The mist parts in a line.
I am coming for you now.
I have measured the angle.
This will go straight.
I start to draw myself straight.
I draw myself taut.
I cannot wait any longer.
I am on my way over.
This very instant.

lines.zh: 我沿着一条直线跟着你。
lines.en: I follow you along a straight line.
You go left, and I re-aim.
I keep aimed at your chest.
I am not fast, but I am straight.
I can hardly see through the mist.
I have drifted off the line again.
I correct the angle little by little.
You have moved behind the pillar.
I cannot get around that pillar.

lines.zh: 我只是一块坏掉的碎片。
lines.en: I am only a broken fragment.
There are more seams on me now.
I keep aiming.
You have moved somewhere else.
I have worked it out again.
The distance is short now.
I straighten my front.

lines.zh: 你的影子帮我看了位置。
lines.en: Your shadow helps me find you.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面找那条直线。
lines.en: I look for the straight line along the ground.

lines.zh: 我把身体拉得又细又长。
lines.en: I draw myself thin and long.
I drive into your shoulder.
My edge cuts once.
That did not land true.
I am caught on you.
I pull free and strike again.
That thrust went deep.

lines.zh: 我撞在你护甲上，滑开了。
lines.en: I hit your armor and slid off.
I am still trying, again and again.
A corner of my edge splits.
I drew back a little.
You slipped that one again.
That one had everything.
I drove it all the way through.
I can hardly hold my shape.
I cut past your side.
That thrust came from below.
I hit, and my edge curls.
I come through from behind you.
A fine seam opens in the air first.
I surface out of the mist.
I take shape, then go crooked.
A faint line appears on the ground.
I hang swaying in mid-air.
My edge is ringing.
The air is cold here.
I try to straighten myself.

lines.zh: 我身上又多出一道裂缝。
lines.en: One more crack has opened on me.
I have come through the fissure.
I check my direction first.
I am still more or less whole.

lines.zh: 热把我的形状烤得更散。
lines.en: The heat scatters my shape further.
I fall, and my edge goes ragged.
Water washes half of me apart.

lines.zh: 爆风把我整个吹开又聚回。
lines.en: The blast scatters me and I gather again.

lines.zh: 有东西从我中间穿过去。
lines.en: Something passed clean through me.
Some force holds me in place.

lines.zh: 我一片一片地变薄下去。
lines.en: I thin away piece by piece.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我一下子散了。
lines.en: Lightning hits and I come apart at once.
There is no bottom and I drift down.
